criteria.note: Public personal-use terms have been reviewed, but the exact intended use, retention period, and eventual product/commercial boundary are not yet accepted for the canonical provider role.
Deterministic backfill and a resumable multi-case EODHD canonical campaign path exist, but paid multi-year active and delisted history has not yet been demonstrated live.
Exact EODHD response capture with secret-free manifests is implemented and integration-tested; live campaign evidence remains to be captured.
ISIN-backed provider identity is supported and provisional ticker identity is rejected by the canonical campaign, but full historical symbol continuity is not demonstrated.
Split/dividend normalization and split-only price materialization are implemented and tested, but representative live corporate-action coverage is not yet demonstrated.

The adapter exposes current and delisted inventories and the evidence plan now requires an explicit delisted-security case, but breadth, history depth, terminal dates/returns, and delisted price coverage remain to be characterized live.

EODHD-specific error classification, bounded exponential retry with jitter, Retry-After handling, and resumable multi-case checkpoint behavior are implemented and tested. Live throttling and recovery behavior still requires provider evidence before this criterion can be demonstrated.
The candidate can traverse identity, adjustment, normalization, quality, provenance, and canonical-promotion gates in deterministic integration tests; live evidence remains outstanding.
Representative EODHD values have not yet been reconciled against an independent secondary source.
Provider-neutral deterministic revision mechanics exist, but an EODHD-specific correction-lookback daily cycle has not yet been demonstrated.
Downstream research consumes canonical Trade Scout contracts and does not import EODHD-native objects.
Current licensing, entitlement, symbol-history, identity, and adjustment limitations are explicitly documented and machine-readable through adapter capabilities.
No representative multi-year real EODHD canonical sample has yet passed the Phase 1 storage and evidence gates.
